card.name: Small words before how or where used
card.fires_on: Small linking words, such as while, within, in, over, or a space before a number, right after a verb of applying, instilling or holding. They come where the text is about to say how, where or for how long something is used.

modes.label: While wearing lenses
modes.description: The word while after 'should not be instilled', just before wearing contact lenses.
modes.example: Difluprednate ophthalmic emulsion should not be instilled<< while>> wearing contact lenses.

modes.label: Duration or timing gap
modes.description: A space or the word within or over just before a number of days or hours.
modes.example: These reactions can occur<< within>> hours to weeks after starting ofloxacin

modes.label: Placing or holding an item
modes.description: A word after a verb of holding, putting or swishing that leads to a body location or device.
modes.example: Instruct the patient to<< put>> the mouthpiece of the inhaler between

card.writes: The promoted words are about installing and installation, while the suppressed words are about wearing and pockets. This suggests little useful output effect, so it has a weak link to placement.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in directions about putting, holding or timing a treatment.
